title: Weekly check-in每周小结测

quiz.q: Simplify 9a−1b3(3a2b−1)2​ using positive exponents.化简 9a−1b3(3a2b−1)2​，用正指数表示。
opts: b5a5​
b5a3​
3b5a5​
ba5​
quiz.hint: Square the top first, then subtract exponents base by base.先把分子平方，再逐个底数相减指数。
quiz.why: Correct: 9a−1b39a4b−2​=a4−(−1)b−2−3=b5a5​.正确：9a−1b39a4b−2​=a4−(−1)b−2−3=b5a5​。
whys: Correct: 9a−1b39a4b−2​=a4−(−1)b−2−3=b5a5​.正确：9a−1b39a4b−2​=a4−(−1)b−2−3=b5a5​。
Sign slip: did 4−1 instead of 4−(−1) when dividing.符号错：相除时算成了 4−1，应是 4−(−1)。
Did not square the 3: (3)2=9 cancels the 9 below.没有把 3 平方：32=9 正好和分母的 9 约掉。
Added −2+3 for b when dividing; dividing subtracts: −2−3=−5.对 b 相除时把指数相加成 −2+3；相除应相减：−2−3=−5。

quiz.q: Factor fully: 4x3+4x2−x−1.完全分解：4x3+4x2−x−1。
opts: (x+1)(4x2−1)
(x+1)(2x−1)(2x+1)
4x2(x+1)
(x+1)(2x−1)2
quiz.hint: Group (4x3+4x2)+(−x−1); the common bracket is (x+1).分组 (4x3+4x2)+(−x−1)，公共括号是 (x+1)。
quiz.why: Correct: 4x2(x+1)−1(x+1)=(x+1)(4x2−1)=(x+1)(2x−1)(2x+1).正确：4x2(x+1)−1(x+1)=(x+1)(4x2−1)=(x+1)(2x−1)(2x+1)。
whys: Stopped early: 4x2−1 is a difference of squares.停得太早：4x2−1 还是平方差。
Correct: 4x2(x+1)−1(x+1)=(x+1)(4x2−1)=(x+1)(2x−1)(2x+1).正确：4x2(x+1)−1(x+1)=(x+1)(4x2−1)=(x+1)(2x−1)(2x+1)。
Lost the −1: factoring −x−1 gives −1(x+1), and that −1 stays.漏了 −1：−x−1=−1(x+1)，这个 −1 要保留。
Treated 4x2−1 as a perfect square; a difference of squares gives (2x−1)(2x+1).把 4x2−1 当成完全平方；平方差应是 (2x−1)(2x+1)。

quiz.q: Factor fully: −6x2+3x+18.完全分解：−6x2+3x+18。
opts: −3(2x+3)(x−2)
−3(2x−3)(x+2)
(−6x−9)(x−2)
−3(x−3)(x+2)
quiz.hint: Take out −3 first, then decompose 2x2−x−6.先提 −3，再拆 2x2−x−6。
quiz.why: Correct: −3(2x2−x−6); ac=−12: −4,3; =−3(2x+3)(x−2).正确：−3(2x2−x−6)；ac=−12：−4 和 3；=−3(2x+3)(x−2)。
whys: Correct: −3(2x2−x−6); ac=−12: −4,3; =−3(2x+3)(x−2).正确：−3(2x2−x−6)；ac=−12：−4 和 3；=−3(2x+3)(x−2)。
Sign mix-up: this gives middle term +x inside, i.e. −3(2x2+x−6).符号弄反：括号内中间项变成 +x，即 −3(2x2+x−6)。
Equal in value but not fully factored: −6x−9 still has the factor −3.值相等但没分解完：−6x−9 里还有公因式 −3。
Used c=−6 instead of ac=−12 and dropped the leading 2.用 c=−6 代替 ac=−12，还丢了首项系数 2。

quiz.q: Factor fully: 81x4−16.完全分解：81x4−16。
opts: (9x2−4)(9x2+4)
(9x2+4)(3x−2)(3x+2)
(3x−2)2(3x+2)2
(9x2−4)2
quiz.hint: 81x4=(9x2)2 and 16=42.81x4=(9x2)2，16=42。
quiz.why: Correct: (9x2−4)(9x2+4), then 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2); the sum stays.正确：(9x2−4)(9x2+4)，再 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2)；平方和保留。
whys: Stopped early: 9x2−4 is again a difference of squares.停得太早：9x2−4 还是平方差。
Correct: (9x2−4)(9x2+4), then 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2); the sum stays.正确：(9x2−4)(9x2+4)，再 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2)；平方和保留。
Factored the sum 9x2+4 as if it were a difference.把平方和 9x2+4 当成平方差分解了。
Treated it as a perfect square; (9x2−4)2 has a middle term −72x2.当成了完全平方；(9x2−4)2 会有中间项 −72x2。

quiz.q: A parabola opens down, has x-intercepts −1 and 7, and passes through (1,6). What is its maximum value?一条开口向下的抛物线，x 截距为 −1 和 7，且过点 (1,6)。它的最大值是多少？
opts: 6
16
3
8
quiz.hint: The axis is the midpoint of the zeros; the extra point only fixes a.对称轴是零点中点；多出来的点只用来求 a。
quiz.why: Correct: y=a(x+1)(x−7), 6=a(2)(−6) gives a=−21​; at x=3: −21​(4)(−4)=8.正确：y=a(x+1)(x−7)，6=a(2)(−6) 得 a=−21​；x=3 时 −21​(4)(−4)=8。
whys: Took the given point as the top; (1,6) is not on the axis x=3.把给的点当成了最高点；(1,6) 不在对称轴 x=3 上。
Skipped finding a (used a=−1); zeros alone do not fix the height.没求 a（直接当 a=−1）；只有零点定不出高度。
Gave the x-coordinate of the vertex; the maximum value is a y-value.给的是顶点横坐标；最大值是纵坐标。
Correct: y=a(x+1)(x−7), 6=a(2)(−6) gives a=−21​; at x=3: −21​(4)(−4)=8.正确：y=a(x+1)(x−7)，6=a(2)(−6) 得 a=−21​；x=3 时 −21​(4)(−4)=8。

quiz.q: A parabola has vertex (2,−8) and passes through (4,0). What are its x-intercepts?抛物线顶点为 (2,−8)，且过 (4,0)。它的 x 截距是什么？
opts: 4 only只有 4
0 and 40 和 4
−8 and 4−8 和 4
−2 and 2−2 和 2
quiz.hint: The axis is x=2, so the known zero 4 has a mirror zero at 0.对称轴是 x=2，已知零点 4 的镜像零点是 0。
quiz.why: Correct: a=(4−2)20+8​=2; 2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4.正确：a=(4−2)20+8​=2；2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4。
whys: Forgot the mirror point: every zero has a partner the same distance on the other side of x=2.忘了对称点：每个零点在 x=2 另一侧等距处都有一个对应零点。
Correct: a=(4−2)20+8​=2; 2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4.正确：a=(4−2)20+8​=2；2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4。
Mixed up heights and intercepts: −8 is the lowest value of y (the vertex height), not a place where the graph crosses the x-axis.把高度和截距弄混了：−8 是 y 的最小值（顶点的高度），不是图象与 x 轴的交点。
Dropped p: solved x2=4 instead of (x−2)2=4.漏了 p：解了 x2=4 而不是 (x−2)2=4。

quiz.q: Simplify (x−1/6x1/2⋅x1/3​)2, x>0.化简 (x−1/6x1/2⋅x1/3​)2，x>0。
opts: x4/3
x2/3
x2
x
quiz.hint: Work only on the exponents: add, subtract a negative, then double.只算指数：相加、减负数、再乘 2。
quiz.why: Correct: 21​+31​+61​=1, then (x1)2=x2.正确：21​+31​+61​=1，再 (x1)2=x2。
whys: Subtracting −61​ was done as subtracting 61​: 21​+31​−61​=32​. Minus a negative is plus.减去 −61​ 被当成减去 61​：21​+31​−61​=32​。减负数等于加。
Multiplied 21​⋅31​ when multiplying powers; same base multiply means ADD exponents.同底数相乘时把指数相乘成 21​⋅31​；应该相加。
Correct: 21​+31​+61​=1, then (x1)2=x2.正确：21​+31​+61​=1，再 (x1)2=x2。
Got the inside right (x1) but forgot the outside power 2.括号里算对了（x1），但漏了外面的平方。

quiz.q: Which is the greatest?哪个最大？
opts: 53​
45​
219​
38​
quiz.hint: Move every coefficient inside by squaring it.把每个系数平方后乘进根号。
quiz.why: Correct: as entire radicals they are 75​,80​,76​,72​.正确：化成整根式分别是 75​,80​,76​,72​。
whys: Picked the largest outside number; 53​=75​ is not the biggest.只看外面的系数最大；53​=75​ 并不是最大。
Correct: as entire radicals they are 75​,80​,76​,72​.正确：化成整根式分别是 75​,80​,76​,72​。
Picked the largest number under the root and ignored the small outside 2: 219​=76​.只看根号里的数最大，忽略了外面的 2 很小：219​=76​。
Simplified to 62​ and compared only the coefficient 6; compare 72​ instead.化成 62​ 后只比系数 6；应比较 72​。
